name: Undercover Skrull — one creature card in graveyard does nothing
notes: Memory: project_skrull_wasp_fixes_2026-06-29. The 'two or more creature cards in your graveyard' condition was unparsed so the boost applied unconditionally. One creature card plus a non-creature (Lightning Bolt) is only one creature card, so Skrull stays a 1/1 Skrull Shapeshifter Villain.
